vulnerability_type: Denial of Service via Restricted Mode

preconditions.description: Contract must be in Restricted state (bot protection enabled)
Attacker must have at least 1 wei of BNRG tokens to initiate a transfer

exploit_hint: When contract is in Restricted state, the launchRestrict modifier updates lastTx for both sender and recipient to block.timestamp. By transferring 1 wei to a victim address, you can set their lastTx to current timestamp, preventing them from making transactions for 60 seconds. Repeatedly transfer small amounts to different victim addresses to lock multiple users out of transactions.
